{{c|''To his Di{{ls}}ciples (by occa{{ls}}ion of Hieru{{ls}}alem and the Temples de{{ls}}truction) he foretelleth, 5 vvhat things {{ls}}halbe before the con{{ls}}ummation of the vvorld, as {{ls}}pecially the Churches ful preaching vnto al nations. 14 Then, vvhat {{ls}}halbe in the very con{{ls}}ummation, to vvit, Antichri{{ls}}t vvith his pa{{ls}}{{ls}}ing great per{{ls}}ecution and {{ls}}eduction, but for a {{ls}}hort time. 24 then incontinent the day of Iudgement, 28 to our great comfort in tho{{ls}}e mi{{ls}}eries vnder Antichri{{ls}}t. 32 As for the moment, to vs it perteineth not to knovv it. 33 but rather euery man to vvatch, that vve be not vnprouided vvhen he commeth to ech one particularly by death.''}}<noinclude>{{rh||Q|And}}</noinclude>
